description:
Priority: P0 | Area: packaging | Labels: feat,area:packaging,P0 | Milestone: v0.0.1 | RFC: W-133 | Task: CTX-0008

Pilot end-to-end publish pipeline for the graphics extension (version 0.0.1).

Owner decision (2026-10-16): component name = graphics (strip bitty- prefix, per net precedent). Binary bitty-graphics, tarball root = bitty-component.toml + bitty-graphics, R2/CDN keys extensions/graphics/0.0.1/<target>.tar.gz + SHA256SUMS, install command bitty extension install graphics --version 0.0.1.

Scope:
- Add bitty-component.toml (name=graphics) plus per-target build/pack wiring using bittys scripts/make-component-dist.sh, mirroring r2-mirror conventions (immutable cache, read-back hash verify).
- Add release/publish CI uploading to the R2 extensions/ prefix (reference org CLOUDFLARE_* secrets by NAME only; wire everything; owner step stays manual: tag push v0.0.1).
- Verification: local pack + tarball member/digest checks, just check, just workflows, cargo gates.

Out of scope: tag push v0.0.1, R2 publish, merge (owner steps; this task opens a PR only).

Context: recon note PX-6496 on bitty CTX-1262 (R2 extension-binary recon); packaging/README.md component dist layout (CTX-1063 #1792); bitty release.yml r2-mirror job.
title: Pilot end-to-end component publish pipeline for graphics 0.0.1
